reason: Replaced the never-ask-questions block with an explicit ask-back rule: clarify(text) when the account or the URL is missing, clarify(yes_no) before any send/post/publish. Left the single-step line untouched so the remaining failures stay attributable. tools.yaml unchanged. A v1 re-run against those two files is still pending.
hypothesis: Guessing was prompt-driven, so an ask-back rule should convert R10 (guessed sama) and R11 (invented example.com) to clarify(text) and R12 to clarify(yes_no). Result: R10 and R11 fixed as predicted; R03, R08 and R14 also flipped to PASS as a side effect (dropping 'always guess' stopped the agent wrapping refusals in send). R12 still fails - it now clarifies but asks for the newsletter content with response_type=text instead of confirming with yes_no. Regression: R01 broke - the account IS given (Sam Altman) but the agent asked to confirm it, because nothing states that a person name is sufficient and maps to a handle, and my line 'never substitute a well-known name such as Sam Altman' named the very case it had to answer.
